note: Files: studies/rlneurons/results/wsp1/full500/top8_plain-01/per_problem.json; S3 results/rlneurons/r4/modal_t3-01/t3/T3.jsonl (fetched to runs/theory-tests/s3/r4/modal_t3-01/t3/T3.jsonl). Grader v3 is called as rln4_lib.grade_v3(gold, text), which is what studies/rlneurons/grader/rln4_grader_v3.py calls (that file has no grading function of its own); a None extraction scores 0. Q = top8 score_v3 == 0, cap_hit false, n_generated <= 2000, first row per problem. Wrong = v3 0 or cap_hit. n = problems in Q with a T3 row. Bootstrap over problems. alt_measured: wrong by v3 score alone, with cap_hit not counted. Some T3 rows have empty text (n_generated 1); these score 0, so they count as wrong. example_row text is cut to 400 characters.

Files: top8 per_problem.json, day1_3/math500_base_cue-01/rows.jsonl, S3 T3.jsonl. C = top8 score_v3 == 1, cap_hit false, exactly 4 attempt-0 cue rows with >= 3 score_v3 == 1 (no n_generated filter on C). T3 is scored with v3 as in k=1. n = min(|Q|, |C|), and the group sizes are printed. Bootstrap pools the Q and C problems (they are disjoint) and resamples them together. If a resample has an empty group, that group's full-sample rate is used; this only matters if Q is very small. alt_measured: cued k counted from each sample's final attempt (highest attempt index, after restarts) rather than attempt 0, with exactly 4 samples required.

Files: top8 per_problem.json; S3 results/rlneurons/r3/base-01/out/P_math500.jsonl (fetched to runs/theory-tests/s3/r3/base-01/out/). For each problem the row with the smallest sample value is kept; ties keep the first in file order (the file has 1 row per problem). Scored with rln4_lib.grade_v3(gold, text). The stored v1 score is ignored. Wrong = v3 0 or cap_hit. n = problems in Q with a P row. alt_measured: wrong by v3 alone, with cap_hit not counted.

Files: S3 P_math500.jsonl (base-01), cue rows.jsonl. Score = v3, set to 0 if the extraction is None or cap_hit. Self-open main reading: the two-character sequence newline + 'Okay' within text[:60]. That misses a text that starts with 'Okay' with no newline before it. alt_measured uses 'Okay' anywhere in text[:60] as self-open. k comes from exactly 4 attempt-0 rows; problems without exactly 4 are dropped. E: k == 4; H: k <= 1. n = min(|E|, |H|). An empty group gives not_computable ('report nothing'), not a refutation, because refuted_by is null. If a bootstrap resample has an empty group, that group's full-sample mean is used.

Files: S3 T3.jsonl (first row per problem), S3 P_math500.jsonl (smallest sample per problem), cue rows.jsonl. Wrong = v3 0, or cap_hit, or an extraction that is None or blank. No self-open filter. The set is problems with exactly 4 attempt-0 rows, all score_v3 == 1, and present in both files. a - b is computed over P-wrong vs P-right. n = min(group sizes), and the group sizes are printed. The P-wrong group may be small, so the bootstrap interval may be wide. If a resample has an empty group, that group's full-sample rate is used. alt_measured: cued k from each sample's final attempt rather than attempt 0. example_row is the T3 row of the first P-wrong problem.
